label: app:core
asserts: the diff at this head touches apps/core/ or shared/; core is in the build manifest. Derived every push, never asserted

label: app:plp
asserts: same, for plp

label: app:pdp
asserts: same, for pdp

label: app:checkout
asserts: same, for checkout

label: itil:standard
asserts: this change is pre-authorised by its type; the diff is limited to apps/**

label: itil:normal
asserts: this change touches the pipeline or the router and needs an approval its type does not grant

label: itil:emergency
asserts: THIS change is the remedy. It passes a freeze and the berth. It is not the estate being shut

label: control-plane
asserts: this change alters how every FUTURE change is verified, so the pipeline cannot verify it and it must not auto-merge

label: labeler:skip
asserts: the manifest is hand-maintained from here. A declared deviation in label form: derived becomes asserted, on purpose

label: change:requested
asserts: a person has asked for this change to begin. The only label a person adds to set one going

label: change:scheduled
asserts: a window is booked on the change schedule. A record; nothing blocks on it

label: change:complete
asserts: validation is done and nothing remains to observe. Terminal for validation, cleared at cleanup

label: change:failed
asserts: TERMINAL closure code. Production never served this build. Nothing to undo

label: change:backed-out
asserts: TERMINAL closure code. Production DID serve it and the estate was returned. Refused without --to <sha>

label: change:backfill-owed
asserts: a change reached main without the normal evidence and still owes the window, the observations and the reason. Blocks nothing; survives settlement

label: change:standard
asserts: legacy class in the lifecycle namespace; renaming it would rewrite the class of every settled change

label: change:normal
asserts: legacy class

label: change:emergency
asserts: legacy class; carried on #2 alongside change:standard, leaving the class undefined

label: release
asserts: a person wants this released. A standing trigger the scheduler consumes; left on, it re-fires

label: release:start
asserts: ACTION. The release has begun for the booked change request, and names which change is in flight. A person cannot truthfully assert this

label: deploy:staging
asserts: THE BERTH. The singleton path to production (:9200) is this change's right now. An action in flight, not a request

label: deploy:production
asserts: a production deploy is in flight. deploy-production.yml fires on it, so a change left carrying it stays armed to re-enter production

label: staging:in-progress
asserts: the staging deploy is running

label: staging:e2e
asserts: the e2e instrument measured the staging environment and it served this build

label: staging:e2e-failed
asserts: same instrument, same environment, opposite verdict. A recorded failure outranks its own pass in guard 4

label: staging:smoke
asserts: smoke measured staging on this build

label: staging:smoke-failed
asserts: smoke refused this build on staging

label: staging:uat
asserts: a PERSON used a named URL and the build served there was this PR's head. The only human-added observation: for acceptance the person IS the instrument

label: production:e2e
asserts: e2e measured the production address on this build

label: production:e2e-failed
asserts: e2e refused this build at the production address

label: production:smoke
asserts: smoke measured the production address on this build

label: production:smoke-failed
asserts: smoke refused this build at the production address

label: production:healthy
asserts: N samples at the production address, every one on this build and exactly one distinct build seen. CONVERGENCE, not liveness

label: blocked:queue
asserts: another open PR holds the berth

label: blocked:lock
asserts: the deployment lock names another run, under 60 minutes old

label: blocked:freeze
asserts: a freeze or an estate emergency covers the requested window

label: blocked:diverged
asserts: main moved under this change by an artifact or hotfix merge. A human may clear it after rebasing

label: freeze
asserts: ESTATE-GLOBAL, on issue #1. Ordinary change is suspended for everyone including the declarer. A property of the WORLD, never of a change

label: emergency
asserts: ESTATE-GLOBAL, on issue #1. An emergency is in flight out there. Blocks standard and normal changes and grants NO exemption to whatever PR carries it

label: staging:passed
asserts: RETIRED: named no measurement and no environment. Replaced by the staging:* stack

label: staging:failed
asserts: RETIRED: same

label: deployed:production
asserts: RETIRED: replaced by change:complete plus the deployment record

label: hold:staging
asserts: REJECTED SEMANTICS. Covered by freeze (the estate stops for everyone) and itil:emergency (precedence). A third stop with a third scope and no rule for which applied
